title: Low-cost algorithm-to-execution framework for surface-code quantum computing
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computing is progressing from demonstrations of individual logical components toward the execution of useful quantum algorithms on large-scale error-corrected processors. Realizing this transition requires co-design across algorithms, fault-tolerant implementations, and hardware resources. Here we develop an algorithm-to-execution framework for low-cost surface-code quantum computing that carries the structure of a computation from hierarchical logical descriptions to circuit-specific spatial organization, non-Clifford resource planning, and physical resource…
